[head=2][color=#684871]Divine Sol Mandate[/color][/head]
The Mandate is an elective imperial order held together by Crown law, charters, military obligation, local custom, guild privilege, and Saintsworn institutions. The Kaiser is chosen by Crown Electors in Conclave; succession is not automatically hereditary.
In Crescent, Count Olywier Rabenau is the charter holder and regional legal center. The Count governs through recognized offices and estates rather than administering every mine or patrol personally.
[head=3][color=#684871]Command and Crown[/color][/head]
- [bold]Lord Admiral.[/bold] Olywier's senior frontier military officer, selected by local nobility and confirmed by the Count. Commands the active fleets and charter forces. - [bold]Imperial Adjutant.[/bold] The Crown Overseer, observer, and diplomatic liaison. Reports independently to Domain and may advise, witness, mediate, object, or authenticate a direct Crown order, but has no routine authority over local fleets. - [bold]Courtier.[/bold] Represents noble patronage, household politics, favors, and the influence of local houses.
[head=3][color=#684871]Estates and support[/color][/head]
- [bold]Knight Banneret[/bold] and [bold]Baronial Ritter.[/bold] The noble martial elite and their armed retainers. - [bold]Minister of Labor.[/bold] Represents burgher industry, labor supply, quotas, guild privileges, and commercial negotiation. - [bold]Knight Logisticar.[/bold] Keeps armies supplied at the boundary between noble service and economic administration. - [bold]Advocatus[/bold] (the Head of Questions) and [bold]Knight Templars.[/bold] Exercise coercive Saintsworn authority over heresy, oath-breaking, prohibited cults, and forged records. - [bold]Freeholder.[/bold] A broad producing estate of workers, miners, technicians, smallholders, and ordinary families, not an automatic class of serfs.
For honorifics, see [textlink="Forms of Address" link="FormsOfAddress"].
